review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As a strategic ally within our Global IT organization, our team of 400+ professionals enables global operations through expertise in Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, and Global Vendor Management. Your primary mission will be to serve as the main liaison and facilitator for internal and external audit requirements, while driving the adoption of the "Holcim Culture" and cybersecurity best practices within legacy technology environments. Audit Support: Act as the primary liaison and facilitator to support internal and external audit requirements. Key Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related fields. Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in IT security, cybersecurity, offensive security, and/or security architecture. Language: English proficiency (Minimum B2 level).
